item.title: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded: The image that was used in this article is non-compliant with the SCP wiki's license (CC BY-SA 3.0) as it comes from here with no indication it has been released under Creative Commons. Thus, the image has been removed.

I entirely agree with the post above. The basic premise is neat and possibly even unique on the site which is saying a lot for such a creative community, but it's lacking a hook to make it really stand out.
Maybe some hint at why the entity is killing beyond "maybe this is how it eats". Could be interesting to find out it's killing for some reason other than sustenance or MUST KILL ALL HUMANS OOOH SO SPOOKY.
If the rating ever goes negative enough to demand staff attention I hope it gets a rewrite rather than deletion.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
its strength when moving is about ████ N - comparable to that of an adult elephant at a dead run

So very scientific.
First, Newtons are units for measuring force, not "strength".
Second, even the force of Earth's gravity on an adult female elephant is about 24500 N.
Third, I believe you should energy (Joules) here. Aforementioned elephant at a dead run would have the kinetic energy of about 125 kJ.
